name: Security capability card grid
purpose: Make five unrelated security mechanisms legible as one coherent product surface, each animating its own behaviour.
cardCountCorrection: ia.json says 'four 320x242 animated cards' and names four mechanisms. The real section renders FIVE: leaked-password, RBAC, password-strength, automatic-detection, multi-factor. The 320x242 geometry and the '1044x492 grid' framing come from the original; the clone's own CSS is a centred flex-wrap row of max-width:320px / height:242px cards with an 8px gap.

perCard.note: Border -active seen at 1077 and 15158; everything cleared at 4050. radar1 -> radar2 is 2017ms, the same step the password card runs on. The per-check-piece 0/0.1/0.2/0.3s delays and the 3s radar sweep are in CSS.

perCard.triggerNote: NOT intersection-gated. Verified by parking the original at scrollY 407 with this block at document y ~4800, far below the fold: it was already writing translateX every frame, the 6050ms opacity clock and the button-shape opacities. At scrollY 0 on load the card ALREADY carries inline translateX(53px).
perCard.anchorNote: Every sub-event is anchored to the moment the ROLE LANDS (= cycle start + the ~820ms decode), not to cycle start. Cycle-start-anchored offsets ran 300-900ms early.
perCard.overlapNote: lightOn (6335) and dotsOn (7036) land AFTER the next cycle has begun at 6050, so they are scheduled as overlapping offsets rather than reset at cycle start.
perCard.shapeLevelNote: The lit button-shape set is PER-ROLE, not one rotating glyph. ADMIN lights all four; VIEWER lights one (index 0); EDITOR lights two (0 and 3). Rest level is 0.4 for all four, dim is 0.2.
perCard.decodeNote: A per-character scramble. Glyphs are redrawn every ~17-33ms and each index locks to its final character at its own random moment inside the ~820ms window (measured lock order for VIEWER was 2,5,0,4,1,3 — randomised, not left-to-right). Locks are drawn as a random PERMUTATION of i/len so the final character lands exactly at the end of the window.
perCard.hardSwitchEvidence: Over 560 consecutive frames light and dots only ever read 0 or 1, and display only 0.4 or 1, all with computed transition-duration 0s. Cross-fading them was a clone defect, now removed.

perCard.note: An EIGHT-state cycle (recorded 16134 / 16150 / 16132). Bar -active additions ran 8075 -> 10092 -> 12109 -> 14124 -> clear 16142 -> next fill 24209: the four filling steps are followed by the empty state being HELD for 8067ms = four more steps. An earlier reading of 5 states / 10020ms missed the hold.
CSS-only. No JS timeline at all — a continuously rotating radar plus five dots.

A 16-step cycle. Ring restarts recorded at 1031 / 17291 / 33558 / 49824 (deltas 16260 / 16267 / 16266). The focus ring walks cell 0->5 one step at a time and each cell becomes -filled exactly one step after it was focused, so the ring is always one cell ahead of the last filled digit. After cell 5 fills, the ring clears and all six stay filled for 9150ms (9 steps) before restarting.
perCard.clockIndependence: This clock is INDEPENDENT of the leaked card's 14081ms clock. An earlier reading locked the two together; on the original they visibly drift apart.

motion.supersedes: CLONE_SPEC 4.2's single ~750ms step; CLONE_SPEC 4.4's unmeasured role list; CLONE_SPEC 3.4's 'clear the interval on exit'.
